title: Soft Thunder
premise: Tavi tries to recover a caravan’s stolen signal bell from an enormous wind-breathing ram. A brief disastrous contest reveals that the ram wants relief from the painful clang, not treasure, and Tavi negotiates an unconventional ride.
emotional_engine: A proud improviser wants to travel on her own terms. She learns what the opponent wants and turns a losing contest into a deal without becoming meek or giving up her ambition.
future_engine: Tavi and a stubborn ram cross living weather-country, taking absurd jobs to reach the far skyports. Her grounded wind-pulse technique grows through timing, breath and using terrain creatively.

style_contract.medium: Rounded expressive cartoon contours, large eyebrows and elastic mouths, opaque block-painted clouds and warm/cool color masses.
style_contract.retain: Muscular charm, broad orange/coral/turquoise palette, enormous creature personality and generous open sky.
style_contract.avoid: Airbrushed plastic, dense individually shaded wool curls, field speckle, fractured ground and particle storms.

cast.name: Tavi Ember
cast.visual: Athletic adult woman, broad expressive face, teal eyes, warm light complexion, short curly coral hair swept up with one forward tuft. Turquoise cropped vest over cream top, loose orange fighting trousers, red ankle wraps and cream boots.
cast.equipment: Rounded red gauntlets: anatomical RIGHT has cream circular pressure plate; anatomical LEFT cream crescent. No initial damage. Turquoise cloth padding strip tied around waist over a cream belt; whole strip can be untied and detached.

cast.name: Mara
cast.visual: Light-skinned stocky female caravan captain, silver braid, ochre poncho, dark trousers, stout boots, small blue neck scarf. Amused pragmatist.
cast.equipment: Plain rope halter and caravan tallybook; no weapon.

cast.name: Gale Ram
cast.visual: Living blue cloud-wool ram twice human height, cream muzzle, orange cheeks, curled blue horns, four stout legs and one cloud tail. Broad grouped wool shapes; no armor.
cast.equipment: Plain brass caravan signal bell approximately human-head height, snagged by its strap on near horn; opening broad enough for bulky gauntlets.

setting: Cream chalk ridge above green windmill hills; wooden caravan platforms and bright cloth sails to LEFT, broad safe grass hollow to RIGHT. A low wooden fence divides paths, with one wide openable gate.

editorial_rules: All story and cast choices are provisional independent pilot options, not owner-selected canon.
Every panel is a new composition. Original anchors guide drawing and appeal, never a collage or reused final panel.
Adult principal cast only. No generated lettering: exact dialogue is editable gallery typography.
Quiet matte floors and grouped surfaces. Preserve medium-defining contour/brush/hatch marks.
One frozen instant per panel. Current-state field is authoritative; never import later damage into an earlier panel.
